label: Bible Study
prompt: And Moses stretched out his hand over the sea; and the LORD caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all that night, and made the sea dry land, and the waters were _____.
verse: And Moses stretched out his hand over the sea; and the LORD caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all that night, and made the sea dry land, and the waters were divided.
note: The Red Sea crossing — note the strong east wind blew all night; the miracle had a night shift.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And I will make them and the places round about my hill a blessing; and I will cause the shower to come down in his _____; there shall be showers of blessing.
verse: And I will make them and the places round about my hill a blessing; and I will cause the shower to come down in his season; there shall be showers of blessing.
note: Rain right on schedule — 'showers of blessing,' a phrase that later became the title of a well-loved hymn.

label: Sunday School
prompt: _____ thy father and mother; (which is the first commandment with promise;)
verse: Honour thy father and mother; (which is the first commandment with promise;)
note: Paul notes that 'Honour thy father and mother' is the first commandment that comes with a promise attached.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD, Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a _____ stone, a precious corner stone, a sure foundation: he that believeth shall not make haste.
verse: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD, Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious corner stone, a sure foundation: he that believeth shall not make haste.
note: God's foundation stone for Zion — Peter applies it to Jesus in 1 Peter 2:6.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And the times of this ignorance God _____ at; but now commandeth all men every where to repent:
verse: And the times of this ignorance God winked at; but now commandeth all men every where to repent:
note: 'God winked at' past ignorance — overlooked it — but now commands all men everywhere to repent.
